environment: Mac M4 Max client; Colima 0.9.1 VZ Linux arm64; Docker Engine 28.4.0; Compose 5.7.0
target_tables: Unpartitioned and logged; both with PK and FK to receipt
guarantees: One synchronous transaction per PUT; receipt and rows commit together; restart verification outside timer

cases.memory_sampling_scope: client only: upload and count verification
cases.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

diagnostics.scope: Activity during concurrent PUTs; no per-stream client yield timing
diagnostics.counter_scope: pg_stat_database: current database; other views: whole cluster
diagnostics.counter_window: Before activity monitor connect through shutdown and 1s collector settle; may include background work and publication lag

cases.label: jsonb-2x5-timed
